milestone: Build and commission a second autonomous mobile robot (AMR) so that two USAMR robots operate simultaneously in a warehouse under a single Fleet Manager. The Fleet Manager will assign and orchestrate transport tasks, coordinate traffic between both robots completing material-handling routes without collision or manual intervention, proving the system works as a fleet.
metrics: 2 autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), 1 fleet manager, 20 customer interviews, 1 pilot project
